notes.title: The game is available NOW
notes.content:
DAMNED!
The game is officially released NOW!

And it is not an april fool ! :)

Thanks for the crownfunders and for Marcus without who nothing would have happen!

After 45 years The Intrepid finally find his way to video games :)

notes.title: Behold! The Intrepid is coming!
notes.content:
DAMNED!

The 1st of april, the Intrepid  lands on Steam with it's very first game: [b]L'intrépide, le futur de l'imparfait[/b] (no joke).

After 45 years of wait, 2 comic books a 1 and a half year of developement, we are proud to announce that the game will soon be ready. Just a few bug smashing and hard working and it will be ready!

See you soon lil'fellows!
